reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for parsing PDFs, Office documents, HTML, and images through MinerU APIs and saving structured Markdown and related artifacts in the workspace.

summaries.zh: 通过 MinerU API 将 PDF、Office 文档、HTML 和图片解析为结构化 Markdown，并将结果保存到工作区。
summaries.en: Parses PDFs, Office documents, HTML, and images through MinerU APIs and saves structured Markdown results to the workspace.

capabilities: Uploads local files or processes document URLs through MinerU APIs
Parses PDFs, Office documents, HTML, and images into structured Markdown
Writes parsed results and metadata to workspace artifact files
Uses an optional MinerU API token for Precision API operations
Polls external parsing tasks and downloads completed results
